label: Technique
description: In-camera techniques that define the shot's physics.

items.name: long-exposure
items.text: long exposure, moving elements smeared into silky trails while the static world stays sharp

items.name: motion-panning
items.text: panning with the subject at a slow shutter, background streaked into horizontal speed lines, subject sharp

items.name: freeze-flash
items.text: high-speed flash freeze at a hair-fine flash duration, motion stopped absolutely mid-action, droplets standing as glass beads and fabric caught in impossible suspended folds

items.name: double-exposure
items.text: in-camera double exposure, a dark silhouette holding a second scene inside itself, the two exposures sharing the frame where the shadows of one let the highlights of the other through

items.name: tilt-shift-miniature
items.text: tilt-shift miniature effect, a real scene rendered as a toy diorama by a sliver of focus

items.name: light-painting
items.text: light painting, hand-drawn ribbons of light traced through a long exposure

items.name: focus-stack
items.text: dozens of focus-bracketed frames blended into impossible front-to-back macro sharpness, crisp from the nearest bristle to the farthest edge with no focus falloff anywhere

items.name: lens-whacking
items.text: freelensing with the lens detached and tilted against the mount, one drifting sliver of the frame in focus, warm light leaks bleeding in across the edges where stray light enters the gap

items.name: zoom-burst
items.text: zoom pulled through its range mid-exposure, the scene exploding outward in radial streaks that converge on one sharp island at the center where the exposure lingered

items.name: through-prism
items.text: shot through a handheld glass prism held at the lens edge, refracted rainbow fringes and a ghosted duplicate of the scene folded across one side of the frame

items.name: underexposed-moody
items.text: deliberately underexposed, shadow-dominant frame with small islands of light

items.name: overexposed-airy
items.text: deliberately overexposed high-key, blown airy whites and floating detail

items.name: intentional-camera-movement
items.text: intentional camera movement through a slow exposure, the scene smeared into painterly directional strokes, color masses surviving where detail dissolves

items.name: stroboscopic-multi
items.text: stroboscopic multi-flash exposure, one motion frozen as overlapping phases marching across a single dark frame

items.name: scheimpflug-plane
items.text: view-camera front tilt laying the plane of focus along the ground itself, near flowers and far peaks sharp together at a wide-open aperture

items.name: shift-verticals
items.text: architectural shift movement, the lens rising instead of the camera tilting, verticals held perfectly parallel from foundation to roofline

items.name: rear-curtain-sync
items.text: slow shutter dragged with rear-curtain flash, ambient light smearing into trails that stream behind the subject before the closing flash snaps one sharp image at the end of the movement
